Gabe: Weekend plan idea  who wants to do a DIY pizza night in the office kitchen Saturday? we can use the big oven, bring toppings, and make it casual.
Harper: i'm sooo in. can we do a gluten-free option?
Lina: love this. i can bring dough for gf and regular. what time?
Marcus: 6pm works for me. can we also have a salad and some drinks?
Gabe: plan: arrive 5:45 to preheat/shape dough, start cooking 6:15. i'll grab tomato sauce + cheese.
Harper: i'll bring gluten-free dough and some pesto + mushrooms. dietary note: i'm dairy-free, can sub vegan cheese.
Lina: noted. i'll bring arugula salad and balsamic.
Marcus: i'll bring sparkling water and some beers. anyone want to split cost?
Gabe: vote: split costs via Venmo? :thumbsup: :thumbsdown:
Harper: vote: venmo ok.
OfficeBot: Kitchen reservation confirmed for Saturday 5:30-8:30 PM. Please clean afterwards.
Lina: also quick heads up: oven uses the odd baking rack. bring mitts!
Marcus: if anyone wants to practice dough tossing, i'll demo.
Gabe: perfect. i'll make a tiny sign-up in the channel for toppings so we don't duplicate. RSVP in thread if you're coming.
Harper: in! thanks Gabe. :pizza::sparkles:
Lina: in too. will add salad details to the signup.
Marcus: count me in. see y'all Saturday.
